dashboard.title: விவசாயி டாஷ்போர்டு
dashboard.allCropsHarvested: அனைத்து பயிர்களும் அறுவடை செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளன அல்லது பட்டியலிடப்பட்டுள்ளன

tips.waterManagementDesc: சொட்டு நீர்ப்பாசனம் 60% வரை தண்ணீரை சேமிக்க முடியும். மண் ஈரப்பதத்தை தொடர்ந்து கண்காணித்து பயிர் தேவைகளின் அடிப்படையில் நீர்ப்பாசனம் செய்யவும்.
tips.waterManagementDescLong: பாரம்பரிய முறைகளுடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது சொட்டு நீர்ப்பாசனம் 60% வரை தண்ணீரை சேமிக்க முடியும். சிறந்த நீர் திறன் மற்றும் அதிக விளைச்சலுக்கு இதை நிறுவுவதைக் கருத்தில் கொள்ளுங்கள்.
tips.optimalPlantingDesc: கரீஃப் பருவம் (ஜூன்-அக்டோபர்) அரிசி, பருத்தி மற்றும் சோளத்திற்கு ஏற்றது. ரபி பருவம் (அக்டோபர்-மார்ச்) கோதுமை, கடுகு மற்றும் கொண்டைக்கடலைக்கு சிறந்தது.
tips.marketTrendsDesc: இயற்கை உற்பத்தி தேவை ஆண்டுக்கு 25% வளர்ந்து வருகிறது. பிரீமியம் விலைகள் மற்றும் சிறந்த சந்தை அணுகலுக்கு இயற்கை விவசாயத்திற்கு மாறுவதைக் கருத்தில் கொள்ளுங்கள்.
tips.postHarvestStorageDesc: சரியான சேமிப்பு அறுவடைக்குப் பிந்தைய இழப்புகளை 30-40% குறைக்க முடியும். காலநிலை-கட்டுப்படுத்தப்பட்ட சேமிப்பைப் பாதுகாக்க எங்கள் கிடங்கு முன்பதிவு அம்சத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்.
tips.governmentSchemeDesc: PM-KISAN திட்டம் இப்போது ₹6,000 ஆண்டு ஆதரவை வழங்குகிறது. உங்கள் வங்கிக் கணக்கில் நேரடியாக பலன்களைப் பெற உங்கள் KYC புதுப்பிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதா என்பதை உறுதிப்படுத்தவும்.

dashboard.title: Farmer Dashboard — Your Farm HQ
dashboard.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your farm in one place.
features: View a live summary of your total land, active crops, and expected yield
Check real-time weather for your farm location
Read today's agri news, disaster alerts, pest warnings & mandi prices
Access AI-powered features: Crop Planning, Quality Assessment & Selling Strategy
Watch a demo video to understand the full platform

steps.title: Check your stats
steps.desc: See total land, active crops & yield at the top.

steps.title: Read today's alerts
steps.desc: Scroll to 'Live Agri News' for weather, pest & disaster alerts specific to your region.

steps.title: Use an AI feature
steps.desc: Click any AI card (Crop Planning, Quality Assessment, Selling Strategy) to get personalised AI guidance.

steps.title: List your produce
steps.desc: Once crops are ready, use 'List Produce' to connect with buyers.

dashboard.tip: Switch the language using the globe icon in the top bar — the entire app including alerts and tips will translate instantly!

cropPlanning.title: AI Crop Planning
cropPlanning.subtitle: Get AI-powered crop recommendations matched to your soil, weather, and market.
features: Select multiple crops and compare them side-by-side
Search from 80+ crop varieties
View a 2D sector map showing how crops divide your field
Get ranked crop suggestions based on your soil type, season and region
Analyse risk scenarios: drought, flood, market price drop

steps.title: Enter your field details
steps.desc: Fill in soil type, water source, and location.

steps.title: Get AI suggestions
steps.desc: Click 'Get Recommendations' — AI ranks the best crops for your conditions.

steps.title: Multi-select crops
steps.desc: Tick multiple crop cards to compare them on the sector map.

steps.title: Explore scenarios
steps.desc: Switch between Risk, Revenue and Yield tabs to understand trade-offs.

steps.title: Save your plan
steps.desc: Click 'Plant This Crop' to lock in your choice and track it in Harvest Management.

cropPlanning.tip: Multi-selecting crops shows how they would share your land visually on the sector map — great for planning mixed cropping.

qualityAssessment.title: AI Quality Assessment
qualityAssessment.subtitle: Upload a photo of your crop and get an instant AI grade with recommendations.
features: Upload or take a photo of your crop at any growth stage
Get an AI grade (A/B/C/D) with an overall quality score
See freshness, damage level, and colour analysis
Receive specific issues detected and personalised recommendations
Directly jump to AI Selling Strategy from the result

steps.title: Select your crop type
steps.desc: Choose the crop from the dropdown list.

steps.title: Pick the growth stage
steps.desc: Select whether it's seedling, growing, flowering, or ready to harvest.

steps.title: Upload a clear photo
steps.desc: Use a well-lit photo — close-up works best. Max 5 MB.

steps.title: Click Analyse
steps.desc: Gemini Vision analyses the photo in seconds and shows a grade.

steps.title: Act on recommendations
steps.desc: Read detected issues and follow AI advice to improve quality or sell wisely.

qualityAssessment.tip: Take the photo in natural daylight for best accuracy. Avoid blurry or dark images.

sellingStrategy.title: AI Selling Strategy
sellingStrategy.subtitle: Know exactly when, where and how much to sell for maximum profit.
features: Get a sell-now vs store-later split recommendation
See live mandi prices and MSP benchmarks auto-fetched
View a price trend forecast for the next few months
Compare revenue for different selling strategies
Inspect the AI's reasoning and confidence score

steps.title: Select crop & variety
steps.desc: Choose your crop variety from 80+ options.

steps.title: Enter yield & harvest month
steps.desc: Specify how much you expect to harvest and when.

steps.title: Auto-fetch mandi price
steps.desc: Click 'Auto-fetch' to pull live market prices for your crop.

steps.title: Set location & storage
steps.desc: Confirm your farm district and whether you have warehouse access.

steps.title: Generate strategy
steps.desc: Click 'Generate AI Selling Strategy' to see the full recommendation.

sellingStrategy.tip: If you have storage access, the AI may recommend holding 30-50% of stock to sell at peak price — this alone can increase revenue by 20-40%.

harvestManagement.title: Harvest Management
harvestManagement.subtitle: Track every crop from planting to sale in real time.
features: View all your active and past crops in one place
Update crop growth stages and log activities
Book warehouses and transport for post-harvest logistics
Mark crops as harvested and list them for sale
Check care tips and recommended actions for each crop

steps.title: Select a crop
steps.desc: Click on any crop card to open its detail view.

steps.title: Log today's activity
steps.desc: Record irrigation, fertiliser, or pest treatment under 'Activities'.

steps.title: Update the growth stage
steps.desc: Move the crop forward as it grows (Sowing → Growing → Harvest Ready).

steps.title: Book storage or transport
steps.desc: Use the Warehouse and Transport tabs to arrange logistics.

steps.title: List when ready
steps.desc: Once harvested, click 'List Produce' to publish it to buyers.

harvestManagement.tip: Logging activities regularly gives the AI better data for future crop planning and quality predictions.

myListings.title: My Produce Listings
myListings.subtitle: View and manage all produce you have listed for buyers.
features: See all your active and completed produce listings
Track buyer offers and negotiation status in real time
Accept or counter-offer from buyers directly
View the full deal roadmap from listing to award
Download invoice once deal is finalized

steps.title: Click on a listing
steps.desc: Open any listing card to see its status and buyer offers.

steps.title: Review offers
steps.desc: Scroll to the Offers section to see what buyers have quoted.

steps.title: Accept or counter
steps.desc: Use 'Accept' to agree or 'Counter' to propose a different price.

steps.title: Track the roadmap
steps.desc: The status workflow shows you exactly where you are in the deal process.

steps.title: Download invoice
steps.desc: Once awarded, scroll to the Invoice section to download your sale receipt.

myListings.tip: Enable browser notifications so you get instant alerts when a buyer submits or updates an offer.

listProduce.title: List Your Produce
listProduce.subtitle: Publish your harvested crop to reach verified buyers.
features: List any harvested crop with quantity, quality grade and asking price
Set a delivery date and pickup location
Add photos for better buyer confidence
Choose between open listing (anyone can offer) or direct sale

steps.title: Select your crop
steps.desc: Choose the crop type and variety from the dropdown.

steps.title: Enter quantity & price
steps.desc: Fill in how much you're selling and your asking price per unit.

steps.title: Add quality details
steps.desc: Select the quality grade (A/B/C) and add any notes.

steps.title: Set location & date
steps.desc: Specify where the buyer can pick up the produce and when.

steps.title: Publish listing
steps.desc: Click 'List Produce' — buyers will see it immediately and can submit offers.

listProduce.tip: Adding a photo of your produce can significantly increase the number of buyer offers you receive.

procurement.title: Browse Buyer Requests
procurement.subtitle: Find buyers actively looking for the crops you grow.
features: Browse live procurement requests from verified buyers
Filter by crop type, location, and quantity
Submit your offer directly from the request detail page
Negotiate price and quantity with buyers through the platform
Track the full deal from offer to contract award

steps.title: Browse requests
steps.desc: Scroll through buyer procurement requests. Filter by your crop type.

steps.title: Open a request
steps.desc: Click a request to see quantity, price expectation, location and delivery date.

steps.title: Submit your offer
steps.desc: Enter your price per unit and available quantity, then click 'Submit Offer'.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.desc: If the buyer counters, you'll get a notification. Review and respond.

steps.title: Deal awarded
steps.desc: Once both sides agree, the deal is finalized and an invoice is generated.

procurement.tip: Buyers can see all farmer offers side-by-side — a competitive price with a strong quality grade wins more deals.

buyerDashboard.title: Buyer Dashboard
buyerDashboard.subtitle: Manage your procurement, listings and negotiations in one place.
features: See all your active procurement requests
Browse farmer listings and submit offers
Track negotiation status and roadmap for each deal
View analytics on spend, quantity, and deals closed

steps.title: Create a request
steps.desc: Click 'Create Procurement Request' to tell farmers what you need.

steps.title: Browse farmer listings
steps.desc: Go to 'Farmer Listings' to see produce available right now.

steps.title: Submit an offer
steps.desc: Open a listing and submit your price and quantity offer.

steps.title: Negotiate & award
steps.desc: Accept or counter-offer until both sides agree. Click 'Propose Award' to finalise.

buyerDashboard.tip: Setting up a procurement request means farmers will approach you with offers — it's more efficient than browsing manually.

buyerProcurement.title: Procurement Requests
buyerProcurement.subtitle: Manage all your active and past buy requests.
features: View all procurement requests you have created
See which farmers have submitted offers
Track negotiation and deal status for each request
Award deals and generate contracts

steps.title: Open a request
steps.desc: Click any request to see all farmer offers received.

steps.title: Compare offers
steps.desc: Review price, quantity, and farmer quality grade side by side.

steps.title: Negotiate
steps.desc: Use 'Counter Offer' to propose adjustments, or 'Accept' to move forward.

steps.title: Award the deal
steps.desc: Click 'Propose Award' to send the deal to the farmer for final confirmation.

buyerProcurement.tip: Use the Status Workflow bar at the top of each request to always know exactly where you are in the deal process.

invoices.title: Invoices & Receipts
invoices.subtitle: View and download official sales invoices and procurement receipts.
features: Browse invoices for all completed deals and purchases
Download GST-compliant PDF receipts with payment details
Track payment status and transaction history
Filter invoices by date range, commodity or partner

steps.title: Find an invoice
steps.desc: Locate the invoice by deal reference number or commodity name.

steps.title: View details
steps.desc: Click 'View' to see the complete price, quantity, and tax breakdown.

steps.title: Download receipt
steps.desc: Click 'Download PDF' to save a copy for your records or accounting.

invoices.tip: Keep your invoice records handy for agricultural subsidy claims and tax filing.

profile.title: User Profile & Settings
profile.subtitle: Manage your account, farm details, location, and preferences.
features: Update your contact details, farm address, and PIN code
Change your preferred language for the whole platform
Manage security settings and password
Set warehouse and vehicle availability

steps.title: Update information
steps.desc: Edit your name, phone number, and location.

steps.title: Save changes
steps.desc: Click 'Save Changes' to update your profile immediately.

steps.title: Select language
steps.desc: Use the language switcher to browse in your mother tongue.

profile.tip: Keeping your farm PIN code accurate ensures you get localized weather and accurate nearest mandi prices.

adminDashboard.title: Admin Portal & Monitoring
adminDashboard.subtitle: Monitor platform activity, user transactions, and system health.
features: View total active farmers, buyers, listings and deals
Track live platform metrics and throughput
Monitor API services and database connections
Audit system activity logs in real-time

steps.title: Review metrics
steps.desc: Inspect key stats on registrations, active listings, and closed deals.

steps.title: Check system health
steps.desc: Navigate to Monitoring to see API latency and error rates.

adminDashboard.tip: System logs update dynamically to help detect bottlenecks and suspicious activities immediately.
